# Current Affairs

> > A left-wing magazine of politics and culture offering socialist analysis, political commentary, and cultural criticism.

Founded and edited by Nathan J. Robinson, Current Affairs publishes essays, interviews, and reviews examining contemporary issues through a progressive lens. The magazine covers topics ranging from elite accountability and labor organizing to animal rights, cultural heritage, and media criticism.

## Key Topics

- Socialism and left politics
- Political commentary and analysis
- Elite accountability and privilege
- Neoliberalism and austerity
- Campus politics and academic freedom
- Labor organizing and strikes
- Animal welfare activism
- Cultural preservation
- Civil liberties and protest rights
- Democratic Party critique
- Trump administration policies
- Media criticism
- Race and social justice
- Religious exemptions and secularism
- Autonomous weapons and technology ethics

## Political Commentary and Analysis

- [The Cowardice of Elites](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/the-cowardice-of-elites): Robinson on elite obligation to resist Trump deportation threats at universities
- [It's Going to Take a Constant Fight to Preserve the Historical Record](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/its-going-to-take-a-constant-fight-to-preserve-the-historical-record): Robinson critiques National Archives censorship under Colleen Shogan
- [The 'Cop City' Indictment Is Preposterous and Terrifying](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2023/09/the-cop-city-indictment-is-preposterous-and-terrifying): Robinson denounces Georgia RICO charges against Atlanta Forest activists
- [The Importance Of Not Having Autonomous Killer Robots](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2018/04/the-importance-of-not-having-autonomous-killer-robots): Robinson warns against U.S. military's autonomous drone swarm development
- [Sometimes The Chicken Kills You, Though](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2020/08/sometimes-the-chicken-kills-you-though): Robinson critiques liberal complacency about Democratic Party shortcomings
- [We Might Just Need to Draft Jon Stewart](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/we-might-just-need-to-draft-jon-stewart): Robinson proposes Jon Stewart as unorthodox 2028 Democratic candidate
- [Are Rural White People The Problem?](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2024/03/are-rural-white-people-the-problem): Robinson critiques book blaming rural America for democratic threats

## Socialist Theory and Practice

- [Neoliberalism and Notre-Dame](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2019/04/neoliberalism-and-notre-dame): Robinson examines how austerity endangers cultural heritage like Notre-Dame
- [How Zizek Should Have Replied to Jordan Peterson](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2019/04/how-zizek-should-have-replied-to-jordan-peterson): Studebaker analyzes missed opportunities in Zizek-Peterson socialism debate
- [For A Luxury Leftism](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2017/01/for-a-luxury-leftism): Essay defending socialism as about abundance and pleasure, not austerity
- [Sober-Minded Socialism](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2021/05/sober-minded-socialism): O'Shea draws lessons for leftist organizing from Alcoholics Anonymous model
- [Whose Fault Is An Uprising?](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2023/01/whose-fault-is-an-uprising): Robinson defends UK rail strikers against media blame-shifting tactics

## Social Justice and Civil Rights

- [There Should Not Be 'Religious Exemptions' To Laws](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2023/08/there-should-not-be-religious-exemptions-to-laws): Robinson argues against religious exemptions in NJ pregnancy discrimination case
- [Q&A: How does race intersect with animal welfare activism?](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/qa-how-does-race-intersect-with-animal-welfare-activism): Interview with Christopher Eubanks on race and animal welfare organizing
- [It's Time To End Horse Racing For Good](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2019/05/its-time-to-end-horse-racing-for-good): McCormick argues Kentucky Derby represents systemic animal cruelty

## Cultural Criticism and Reviews

- [Elvis Like You've Never Seen Him Before](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2023/01/elvis-like-youve-never-seen-him-before): Moloney reviews how Baz Luhrmann's Elvis biopic refreshes familiar story
- [A Comedy of Errors](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2019/09/a-comedy-of-errors): How Nollywood comedy provides escapism amid Nigeria's challenges
- [The World of Wodehouse](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2020/03/the-world-of-wodehouse): Rennix explores P.G. Wodehouse's delightful but problematic comic fiction

## Optional

- [Quiz: Which Dystopia Have I Found Myself In?](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2018/04/quiz-which-dystopia-have-i-found-myself-in): Gold's satirical interactive quiz about possible dystopian futures
- [What's In Our March/April Issue](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/2016/03/whats-in-our-marchapril-issue): Table of contents for Current Affairs March/April print magazine issue
